summary.tagline: Borgarfjörður eystri (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈpɔrkarˌfjœrðʏr ˈeistrɪ] ) is a fjord in east Iceland.

days.title: Village and Coastal Landmarks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bakkagerði
stops.detail: Once you have rounded this cape, the view opens up to the village of Bakkagerði.

stops.name: Álfaborg
stops.detail: The fjord derives its name from "Álfaborg", in German "Elf Hill", a stony hill in the immediate vicinity of Bakkagerði.

stops.name: Staðarfjall
stops.detail: Similar to Berufjörður, some of the mountains show basalt intrusions, including at the summit; this is particularly noticeable on Staðarfjall (620 m).

stops.name: Njarðvíkurskriður
stops.detail: Above is an erosion slope called Njarðvíkurskriður.

stops.name: Vatnsskarð eystra

stops.name: Hvítserkur
